## Overview

This document creates a dementia category table summarizing the distribution of 2,491 participants across six cognitive transition categories for the EWAS manuscript.

## Introduction

Create a dementia category table for the subjects used in the OLS association analysis. This notebook does not collapse the dementia categories. The follow-up column and the numbers in its footnotes are computed from the analyzed participants (reviewer round, R1.3), with the same sources and rule as `demographics/04_followup_timeline.qmd`.


```{r}
tic("Read DNAm data")
m <- read_rds(here("data/collaborator_only/covariates_and_meth_DMP_on_chr21.rds")) |>
  # Keep relevant columns
  dplyr::select(subr_id18, a1age, sex, a1smokingstatus, dementia_ages1_eos, starts_with("cg")) |>
  # Exclude subjects with missing smoking status (n=5)
  filter(!is.na(a1smokingstatus))
toc()

glimpse(m[, 1:10])
```


## Dementia Status

```{r}
dm <- 
  m[, 1:10] |> 
  count(dementia_ages1_eos, sort = F) |>
  rename("dementia" = dementia_ages1_eos, "count" = n) |> 
  # Compute percentage
  dplyr::mutate(percentage = count/sum(count)) |> 
  # Convert dementia to character. Otherwise, 
  # in gt table, should specify location like locations = cells_stub("2"), 
  # not locations = cells_stub("MCI")
  mutate(dementia = as.character(dementia)) 
  
dm

```

## Follow-up time

The follow-up column was typed in for the submission from an extract of 2,496 participants, before the 5 with missing smoking status were excluded; it is now computed on the 2,491. The rule is the collaborator's `FU_DAYS`, as reproduced in `demographics/04_followup_timeline.qmd`: the time from AGES-I to dementia diagnosis, death or the end of surveillance, except for normal2mci and stable_mci participants who attended AGES-II, whose follow-up ends there; prevalent dementia has 0.

```{r}
#| label: followup

dem_cat <-
  read_rds(here("data/collaborator_only/covariate_dementia_cat.rds")) |>
  dplyr::select(subr_id18, time_in_days, in_ages2) |>
  mutate(subr_id18 = tolower(as.character(subr_id18)))

visits <-
  read_sas(here("data/collaborator_only/rai_a1a2cogstat2016_jan2017_reva.sas7bdat")) |>
  transmute(
    subr_id18 = tolower(SUBR_ID18),
    date_ages1 = BOOKDATE_IC,
    days_ages1_to_ages2 = DAYS_AGES_AGESII,
    date_end_surveillance = most_recent_fup_date
  )

followup <-
  m |>
  transmute(subr_id18 = tolower(as.character(subr_id18)), transition = as.character(dementia_ages1_eos)) |>
  inner_join(dem_cat, by = "subr_id18") |>
  left_join(visits, by = "subr_id18") |>
  mutate(
    attended_ages2 = in_ages2 == 1,
    date_ages2 = date_ages1 + days_ages1_to_ages2,
    fu_days = if_else(transition %in% c("normal2mci", "stable_mci") & attended_ages2, days_ages1_to_ages2, time_in_days)
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(followup) == nrow(m),
  !anyNA(followup$fu_days),
  !anyNA(followup$date_ages1),
  all(!is.na(followup$days_ages1_to_ages2) == followup$attended_ages2)
)

days_per_year <- 365.25

followup_by_group <-
  followup |>
  summarise(
    followup_mean = round(mean(fu_days, na.rm = TRUE)),
    followup_sd = round(sd(fu_days, na.rm = TRUE)),
    surveillance_years = mean(time_in_days, na.rm = TRUE) / days_per_year,
    .by = transition
  )

# Two rows differ from the submitted Table 1 (stable_normal 3,869 (773) and normal2incid
# 2,730 (905), from 2,496 participants); the other four are unchanged.
followup_expected <- tribble(
  ~transition,     ~mean_expected, ~sd_expected,
  "stable_normal", 3870,           774,
  "normal2mci",    1921,           139,
  "stable_mci",    2104,           1020,
  "normal2incid",  2734,           906,
  "mci2incid",     2239,           720,
  "prev",          0,              0
)

followup_check <- inner_join(followup_by_group, followup_expected, by = "transition")

stopifnot(
  nrow(followup_check) == 6,
  all(followup_check$followup_mean == followup_check$mean_expected),
  all(followup_check$followup_sd == followup_check$sd_expected)
)

followup_by_group
```

The footnotes state the examination years, AGES-II attendance, the end of surveillance, the maximum follow-up and the dementia-surveillance time of the two MCI groups without dementia. Each is computed here and checked against the value the manuscript prints.

```{r}
#| label: footnote-facts

surveillance_end <- unique(followup$date_end_surveillance)

fn_facts <- list(
  ages1_years = glue("{year(min(followup$date_ages1, na.rm = TRUE))}–{year(max(followup$date_ages1, na.rm = TRUE))}"),
  ages2_years = glue("{year(min(followup$date_ages2, na.rm = TRUE))}–{year(max(followup$date_ages2, na.rm = TRUE))}"),
  n_ages2 = scales::comma(sum(followup$attended_ages2, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n_stable_mci_ages2 = sum(followup$attended_ages2[followup$transition == "stable_mci"], na.rm = TRUE),
  surveillance_end = str_squish(format(surveillance_end, "%e %B %Y")),
  fu_max_years = sprintf("%.1f", max(followup$fu_days, na.rm = TRUE) / days_per_year),
  surveillance_normal2mci = sprintf("%.1f", followup_by_group$surveillance_years[followup_by_group$transition == "normal2mci"]),
  surveillance_stable_mci = sprintf("%.1f", followup_by_group$surveillance_years[followup_by_group$transition == "stable_mci"])
)

stopifnot(
  length(surveillance_end) == 1,
  fn_facts$ages1_years == "2002–2006",
  fn_facts$ages2_years == "2007–2011",
  fn_facts$n_ages2 == "2,025",
  fn_facts$n_stable_mci_ages2 == 26,
  fn_facts$surveillance_end == "4 October 2015",
  fn_facts$fu_max_years == "13.4",
  fn_facts$surveillance_normal2mci == "10.0",
  fn_facts$surveillance_stable_mci == "8.7",
  # The footnote says normal2mci follow-up ends at the AGES-II examination, so every
  # normal2mci participant must have attended it.
  all(followup$attended_ages2[followup$transition == "normal2mci"])
)

fn_facts
```

## Refine dementia category tibble

The Baseline and Follow-up status cells are assigned by position, so the order of `dm` is checked first; the follow-up columns are joined by group.

```{r}
stopifnot(identical(dm$dementia, c("stable_normal", "stable_mci", "normal2mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev")))

dm_refined <-
  dm |>
  # Add additional columns
  mutate(
    # Add an order column
    order = c(1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 6),
    # dementia_transition = if_else(dementia == "prev", "prevalent dementia", glue("{dementia} transition"))) |>
    # Add baseline and follow-up dementia category - order: stable_normal, stable_mci, normal2mci, normal2incid, mci2incid, prev
    Baseline = c("normal", "mci", "normal", "normal", "mci", "dementia"),
    Followup = c("normal", "mci", "mci", "incid", "incid", "dementia")
  ) |>
  # Add follow-up time (days), computed above
  left_join(followup_by_group |> dplyr::select(dementia = transition, followup_mean, followup_sd), by = "dementia") |>
  # Reorder the dementia column
  dplyr::arrange(order) |>
  rename(transition = dementia) |>
  relocate(transition, Baseline, Followup, .before = count) |>
  dplyr::select(-order)

stopifnot(!anyNA(dm_refined$followup_mean), !anyNA(dm_refined$followup_sd))

dm_refined
```

## Base table

Create the base table

```{r}

dm_base <-
 dm_refined |>
 gt::gt(rowname_col = "transition") |>
 # Format columns before merging
 fmt_number(columns = c(count), decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) |>
 fmt_percent(columns = c(percentage), decimals = 1) |>
 fmt_number(columns = c(followup_mean, followup_sd), decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) |>
 # Merge columns: count (percentage) and followup_mean (sd)
 cols_merge(
   columns = c(count, percentage),
   pattern = "{1} ({2})"
 ) |>
 cols_merge(
   columns = c(followup_mean, followup_sd),
   pattern = "{1} ({2})"
 ) |>
 # Move follow-up column before count
 cols_move(
   columns = followup_mean,
   after = Followup
 ) |>
 # Label columns
 cols_label(
   count = "N (%)",
   Followup = "Follow-up status",
   followup_mean = "Follow-up, days"
 ) |>
 ## Add footnotes (reviewer round, R1.3 and R1.7); the numbers come from the footnote-facts chunk
 tab_footnote(footnote = md(glue(
                "Mean (SD) from AGES-I, defined by group: stable_normal, to death or {fn_facts$surveillance_end}; ",
                "normal2mci, to the AGES-II examination at which MCI was diagnosed; ",
                "stable_mci, to AGES-II for the {fn_facts$n_stable_mci_ages2} who attended it, otherwise to death or {fn_facts$surveillance_end}; ",
                "normal2incid and mci2incid, to dementia diagnosis; prev, none. Maximum {fn_facts$fu_max_years} years."
              )),
              locations = cells_column_labels(columns = followup_mean)) |>
 tab_footnote(footnote = md(glue(
                "Cognitive status at the end of follow-up. MCI was assessed only at AGES-I (baseline, {fn_facts$ages1_years}) ",
                "and AGES-II ({fn_facts$ages2_years}); ",
                "dementia was also ascertained from records to {fn_facts$surveillance_end} (Figure S1)."
              )),
              locations = cells_column_labels(columns = Followup)) |>
 tab_footnote(footnote = md("Mild cognitive impairment."),
              locations = cells_body(columns = Baseline, rows = 3)) |>
 tab_footnote(footnote = md("Incident dementia."),
              locations = cells_body(columns = Followup, rows = 4)) |>
 tab_footnote(footnote = md(glue(
                "No dementia was recorded in these groups during surveillance to death or {fn_facts$surveillance_end} ",
                "(mean {fn_facts$surveillance_normal2mci} years for normal2mci and {fn_facts$surveillance_stable_mci} years for stable_mci)."
              )),
              locations = cells_stub(c("normal2mci", "stable_mci"))) |>
  tab_footnote(footnote = md("Prevalent dementia."),
              locations = cells_stub("prev")) |>
 tab_options(footnotes.multiline = FALSE) |>
 ## Add grand summary for count only (merged column)
 grand_summary_rows(
   fns = lst(total = ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
   columns = count,
   fmt = ~ fmt_number(.x, use_seps = TRUE, decimals = 0)
 ) |>
 ## Font style
 tab_style(
   style = list(cell_text(
     size = 6,
     color = "black",
   )),
   locations = lst(
     cells_body(columns = everything()),
     cells_stub_grand_summary(),
   )
 ) |>
 tab_style(
   style = list(cell_text(
     color = "grey20",
     weight = "bold"
   )),
   locations = lst(
     cells_column_labels(),
     cells_stub(),
     cells_stub_grand_summary()
   )
 )


dm_base
```

## Indicate "Normal" as ref. 

The style using "em" as tag have effects only when running from the console, not rendering to html file. But the style using "span" as tag works in both cases. 

```{r}
#| column: screen

dm_full <- 
dm_base |>
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_stub("stable_normal"),
    fn = function(x) {
      # paste("Normal <em style=\"font-size: 10px; color: red;\"> (ref) </em>")
      # "Normal <em style='font-size: 10px; color: darkred;'> (ref) </em>"
      # paste("Normal <span style=\"font-size: 10px; color: red;\"> (ref) </span>")
      "stable_normal <span style='font-size: 10px; color: darkred;'> (ref) </span>"
    }
  )

dm_full
```

## Save the table

```{r}

fs::dir_create(here("demographics/output"))
# Base table
dm_base |>
  write_rds(here("demographics/output/dementia_category_table_base.rds")) |>
  gtsave(file = here("demographics/output/dementia_category_table_base.png"), expand = 10, vwidth = 800, vheight = 1400, zoom = 2)

# Full table
dm_full |>
  write_rds(here("demographics/output/dementia_category_table_full.rds")) |>
  gtsave(file = here("demographics/output/dementia_category_table_full.png"))
```
